plan.estimand: Total development sample size for binary clinical prediction model via Riley criteria optimizing for precision of predictions
assumptions: Binary outcome prediction model
Riley precision-based criteria (not events-per-variable)
Shrinkage factor = 0.90 applied to developed model
pmsampsize package version 1.1.3 default precision criteria
Nagelkerke R-squared scale for performance metrics
Maximum absolute difference between apparent and adjusted R-squared (Nagelkerke) on shrunk model ≤ 0.05
Average predicted risk margin of error ≤ 0.05 at derived sample size
scientific_notes: Request specifies pmsampsize 1.1.3 implementation of Riley criteria for binary prediction models
User explicitly requests NOT to use events-per-variable rules—focus is precision of predictions (calibration and discrimination)
Shrinkage 0.90 is user-specified; this affects optimism-adjusted performance metrics
Two precision targets: (1) R-squared calibration difference ≤0.05 (Nagelkerke) and (2) average outcome-risk margin ≤0.05
User requests verification of margin-of-error precision at returned sample size
Structured reporting metric: sample_size in units of participants_total
All numerical outputs must be grounded in executed R code using pmsampsize package
